def f(inp):
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(inp) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==8]
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]

    return [[8 if pat[r][c] else 0 for c in range(len(cs)*2)] for r in range(len(rs))]

    pat=[[1 if (r,cs[0]+c) in cells else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in rs]
    return [[8 if pat[r-rs[0]][c%w] else 0 for c in range(w*2)] for r in rs]
